metadata.title: InterasisAI Connect — The architecture behind support that never fumbles the answer
metadata.description: See the RAG architecture that makes InterasisAI Connect answer like someone who already read everything about your business — no menus, no hallucination, 24/7.

eyebrow: The difference shows up in the first message
title: A chatbot offers options. InterasisAI Connect already knows the answer.
lead: Most automated support makes the customer pick option 1, 2, or 3 — and breaks the moment they type something else. InterasisAI Connect read the business documents before it ever started. It understands the question and answers directly.

architecture.title: It read everything about the business before the first conversation
architecture.description: Common automated support needs someone to register questions one by one. InterasisAI Connect works the other way around: the business hands over the documents it already has, and it learns from them — no reprogramming needed when something changes.
architecture.analogy: It's like hiring someone and handing them the folder with everything about the business: prices, rules, hours, what's allowed and what isn't. That person reads it all before day one and can then support any customer with confidence — except it happens in minutes, nothing is ever forgotten, and it works at 3am too.
architecture.highlight: Prices changed? Just swap the document. It relearns on its own — no reprogramming needed.

comparisonTable.title: Where the difference shows up, in practice

rows.label: How the customer asks

rows.connect: Types however they want, like talking to a person

rows.label: Where the answer comes from
rows.common: From manually registered phrases, one by one
rows.connect: From the business's real documents, read in full

rows.label: Information that changes
rows.common: Stays outdated until someone reprograms it
rows.connect: Checks the schedule and data at the moment of the question

rows.label: When it doesn't know something
rows.common: Repeats the menu or says "I didn't understand"

rows.label: To update it
rows.common: Call support and reprogram the flow

rows.label: Risk of a wrong answer
rows.common: Answers out of context when the menu doesn't cover it

items.title: Initial conversation
items.description: We learn how support works today and which questions come up most. No cost, no commitment.

items.title: Setup
items.description: It reads the business documents; we define its tone and the limits of what it can answer on its own.

items.title: Custom adjustments
items.description: If it needs to connect to the schedule or the system already in use, that's set up and agreed in writing.

items.title: Live, with support
items.description: We follow the first real conversations and fine-tune. The first month of support is included.
